attempts.text:
Khushi Patel Chartered Accountant

+91 83204 55301 Email : ca.khushipatel610@gmail.com

LinkedIn : LinkedIn Profile

Professional Summary

Chartered Accountant with practical experience in Banking & Finance, Trade Finance, Accounting, Taxation, GST Compli-
ance and Audit. Experienced in managing Letters of Credit (LCs), Bank Guarantees (BGs), corporate banking operations,
bank reconciliations, tax compliance, GST reconciliations and financial reporting. Proficient in Microsoft Excel and Mi-
crosoft Word, with working knowledge of accounting software.

Education Qualification

Course Institution Marks Year
CA Final Institute of Chartered Accountants of India 300/600 Jan 2026
CA Intermediate (Group 2) Institute of Chartered Accountants of India 251/400 May 2023
CA Intermediate (Group 1) Institute of Chartered Accountants of India 224/400 Nov 2022
CA Foundation Institute of Chartered Accountants of India 239/400 Dec 2021
B.Com Veer Narmad South Gujarat University 7.33 CGPA Apr 2024
Class XII-GSEB L.H. Boghra School, Surat, Gujarat 683/750 May 2021
Class X-GSEB L.H. Boghra School, Surat, Gujarat 554/600 Mar 2019

Work Experience

Associate Executive – Banking & Finance June 2026 – Present
Amnex Infotechnologies Pvt. Ltd.

• Executed day-to-day corporate banking operations, including posting accounting entries for banking transactions, maintaining
banking records and supporting bank reconciliations.

• Managed the end-to-end processing of Letters of Credit (LCs) and Bank Guarantees (BGs), including issuance, amend-
ments and closures, while coordinating with banks to ensure timely execution of trade finance transactions.

• Coordinated with banking partners for opening and maintenance of share application bank accounts, ensuring timely
completion of documentation and regulatory requirements.

• Managed corporate e-Banking administration for trade finance activities, including customer ID creation, transaction rights
management and banking documentation.

Article Assistant March 2023 – March 2026
Kamlesh A. Lilwani & Co., Chartered Accountants, Surat

Accounting, Reporting & Finance

• Maintained books of accounts and prepared financial statements for Individuals, HUFs and Partnership Firms in accordance
with applicable accounting principles.

• Performed ledger scrutiny, account reviews and reconciliations to ensure accuracy of accounting records and identify
discrepancies.

• Prepared Credit Monitoring Arrangement (CMA) reports, projected financial statements, budgets and financial forecasts
for working capital and term loan assessments.

Taxation (Income Tax & GST)

• Prepared and filed 60+ Income Tax Returns (ITRs) for Individuals, HUFs and Partnership Firms, ensuring compliance with
the Income-tax Act, 1961.

• Managed direct tax compliance, including Chapter VI-A deductions, TDS reconciliation with Form 26AS, AIS and TIS, and
quarterly TDS returns through Forms 24Q, 26Q and 26QB.

• Managed GST compliance, including GSTR-1, GSTR-3B and GSTR-9 filings, GST reconciliations using GSTR-2A/2B,
and preparation of GST refund applications under the Inverted Duty Structure.

Audit and Assurance

• Worked as a tax audit team member for 10+ tax audit engagements, including preparation of Form 3CB–3CD, adhering
to statutory tax provisions and compliance standards.

• Verified financial records and supporting documents to support tax audit procedures and ensure accurate reporting of financial
information.

• Coordinated with clients for collection of financial data, identification of discrepancies and preparation of audit docu-
mentation to facilitate timely completion of audit assignments.

Certificates and Skills

• Proficient in MS-Excel and MS-Word; working knowledge of Genius, Tally and MCS accounting software.

• Completed AICITSS and MCS courses prescribed by ICAI.

• Completed Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) course.

1

mailto:ca.khushipatel610@gmail.com
https://www.linkedin.com/in/khushi-patel-961810282/
